title: The Social Reckoning is flopping at the box office
summary: The Social Reckoning, Aaron Sorkin's follow-up to The Social Network, has underperformed significantly at the box office, grossing only $5.5 million against a $30-42 million budget. This represents a substantial loss for Columbia Pictures and Sony.
content:
As important as some of the messages in The Social Reckoning are, the movie has been drastically underperforming at the box office. Per Variety, Aaron's Sorkin's follow up to The Social Network only grossed a measly $5.5 million this past weekend against a budget that's somewhere within the $30-42 million range. That would make it a certifiable flop that's costing Columbia Pictures (and Sony) quite a bit of money - especially when you compare it to The Social Network's $22 million opening. 
This isn't entirely surprising given how middling reviews for the film have been. It's currently got a 55% rating on Rotten Tomatoes and has widely been …

summary: GM is constructing a Battery Cell Development Center in Michigan to research and prototype advanced EV battery cells aimed at dramatically reducing costs. The facility represents GM's critical push to compete in high-volume affordable electric vehicle markets.
content:
If you're driving through GM's sprawling campus in Warren, Michigan, you'd likely ignore the pair of adjacent, anonymous white buildings tucked away in the upper reaches of the 710-acre space.
Inside those buildings, which total half a million square feet together, is a massive construction project that's still in progress. Once completed, it will house GM's new Battery Cell Development Center, where the automaker is working furiously to build new prototype cells with the goal of slashing the cost of its EVs.
